entries.a56d9fae88a5e77a: A reportable segment that provides solutions for corporate marketing activities, such as planning, selling and placing advertising products. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,154 million (up 2.5% from the previous year), and the segment loss was ¥12 million (compared with a loss of ¥85 million in the previous year). The securities report states that although sessions on the comprehensive information site "All About" decreased owing to changes in the search environment caused by AI, programmatic advertising unit prices remained firm thanks to a shift toward high-unit-price content, the Global Marketing Business grew as commissions for inbound marketing measures, mainly from government agencies and local governments, expanded, and the Digital Marketing Business also increased its sales. The segment is also working to develop revenue sources other than programmatic advertising, such as PrimeAd and the Financial Life Support Business.

entries.ec40a7a18b2d0f95: This is a category that the securities report describes as "business segments not included in reportable segments," and it includes the bank agency business and others. The main businesses of Mirai Bank Co., Ltd. (bank agency business and provision of financial information services; the Company's ownership of voting rights: 100.0%), which became a consolidated subsidiary when all of its shares were acquired on May 26, 2025, are also printed as the bank agency business. The notes on business combinations state that, through a partnership with Sumishin SBI Net Bank, Ltd., it provides various financial products and services under the "Mirai Bank" brand, and that its main source of revenue is fees from home loans. The table of segment information for the previous fiscal year has no "Other" column, and its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is smaller than that of either of the two reportable segments. Because it is not included in the reportable segments, it is placed last regardless of the order of revenue.
